title: Dependency Vulnerability Policy Compiler
description: Compiles the dependency vulnerability scanning policy. Enforces: critical vulnerabilities block the build, high vulns have remediation SLAs, all exceptions reference a vuln-exception-record, and all package ecosystems (npm, pip, go, etc.) are covered.

error_codes.DV001: dep-vuln-spec.json missing or invalid — required fields: ecosystems[], severity{}, scanTool
error_codes.DV002: Critical severity vulnerabilities do not block the build — CVSS ≥9.0 must fail CI
error_codes.DV003: High severity vulnerabilities have no remediation SLA — define maxDays for high-severity findings
error_codes.DV004: Vulnerability exception has no reference to a vuln-exception-record — all exceptions must be formally waivered
error_codes.DV005: Not all package ecosystems used in the project are covered by the scanning policy
